answer: Randomized spot-check audits resist sybils: a random fraction s of accepted work is pulled for deep re-audit, and any forged result is slashed by penalty P. Forging pays only while gain beats expected loss, so once s times P exceeds the per-item reward the expected value of a fake answer turns negative and the whole farming voyage stops paying. Flagged lineages escalate s, climbing a trellis of tightening scrutiny no forge can outrun. Detection need only be costly enough in expectation to bankrupt the swarm.
